title: knautia arvensis var. carpathica
intro: Knautia arvensis var. carpathica, commonly known as the Balkan burnet-saxifrage, is a plant species within the family Dipsacaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Knautia arvensis var. carpathica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may contribute to its analgesic, anti-edematous, and anti-ulcerogenic effects. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy of the plant and its constituents for human health.
